verdict.rationale: Google Workspace is an identity and admin platform, so agent identity is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence covers only human-user identity controls: SSO, SAML apps, Context-Aware Access, 2SV, user provisioning and the Cloud Identity API. Nothing documents AI agents as first-class identities, cross-app access for agents, token vaulting, or scoped agent credentials. These are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)
